system: Khai Minh Effect Candidate Registry (FX01–FX12) — Phase A.1 Refined

referenceTaxonomyRules.OBSERVED_VERIFIED_PATTERN: Confirmed through direct observation of live interaction behavior.
referenceTaxonomyRules.OBSERVED_CONTENT/MOOD: Direct observation of aesthetic atmosphere and thematic tone.
referenceTaxonomyRules.DESIGN_INSPIRATION: Conceptual design influence without asserting identical technical implementation.
referenceTaxonomyRules.REFERENCE_HYPOTHESIS: Plausible interaction pattern inferred from UX presentation.
referenceTaxonomyRules.STUDENTHUB_ORIGINAL_DERIVATION: Original technical/creative adaptation specific to StudentHub Khai Minh identity.
